title: The Pale Horse
subtitle: The warhorse is bridled, waiting for the coming tempest.

items.text: The Pale Horse
The flight unit makes a slow descent as they circle above the plains.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hmm.
Their temporary captain remains lost in silent thought.

items.speaker: Alpha Two
items.text: There was nothing at the coordinates Igor sent us. Do you think he lied to us, Lieutenant?

items.speaker: Alpha Two
items.text: Achoo!
Those in the air sense the changes in weather before the creatures of the earth do. A sharp wind sends a shiver through their ranks.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The weather's gotten colder every time we destroyed a rite. I don't see why he'd only trick us with the last site.

items.speaker: Alpha Two
items.text: Then what's going on? You can't move rites around, can you?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Beats me. How's everyone holding up? If it's too cold, we can fly low until we get on some extra layers.
They'd been waiting for those words. The white-clad Witches immediately lower their altitude.

items.speaker: Alpha Two
items.text: *cough*
Her mouth falls open, her eyes wide as blood gushes from the hole blasted in her neck.
Her aircraft spirals out of control, flinging its lifeless pilot from its back.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Alpha Two!!
Lilya plunges into a near-vertical dive, catching the falling Witch before she hits the ground.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Rrrgh!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Alpha One and Three, break formation and stay low! Flush out the shooter.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Get a grip, the rest of you! Alpha Four, Five, and Six, pull up and stay out of range of those rats on the ground!

items.speaker: Alpha Four
items.text: Lieutenant!
Alpha Four circles low, igniting the dry riverside reeds and revealing the black-clad forces hidden among them.

items.speaker: Alpha Four
items.text: The Manus are gaining on us!
Lilya crouches and gently closes her wingmate's eyes.
She grabs Red 38 and stands, the fire of the burning reeds blazing in her eyes.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Good. They can watch as I tear them apart piece by piece!
She wipes the blood from her cheek.
Warm and red, from a pilot who had just moments ago been scratching her head in bewilderment. A whole life lost, just like that.
The Flying Witches descend, landing nearby.

items.speaker: Alpha Four
items.text: Lieutenant.
A faint light returns to her dull, weary eyes.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Take her to Bereggrad along with Alpha Five. We'll bring her home once the battle's over.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The rest of us will keep looking for the last rite. Mission's clear: the Manus must be stopped.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I want everyone watching for threats from the ground at all times. We can't let this happen again.
She watches as the team forms up and rises again.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Goddammit!
Only when they disappear into the clouds does she let out a deep sigh, her back sinking as she buries her face in her hands.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hey, Captain.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you alright, Lilya?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto and I have been trying to contact you for the past hour.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: *phew* Sorry, Manus rats kept me busy.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: About 42 miles southeast of Bereggrad, my squadron was ambushed by the Manus. Alpha Two didn't make it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My condolences.
A heavy grief and anxiety hangs between them, the silence only deepened by the moaning wind outside.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We've got some bad news of our own.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Around midnight, the command post lost contact with the frontline cavalry.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We haven't heard anything from Bereggrad either.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Scouts reported flares upriver. There may yet be survivors. A flight unit's eyes would tell us for certain.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I'm on it. What about the city?
Igor stands up from the sand table.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: My soldiers are responsible for the city's defense. I will go there myself to assess the situation.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: You promised to stay in the sich, Igor.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: A promise I intended to keep. But as you can see, we're struggling on multiple fronts, and our enemy remains hidden.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: We all know this coalition's collapse is imminent. We must act.
After a beat, the commander speaks.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: I'll lend you a horse.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Appreciated, but I will need more than that.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: What is it?

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: This.
Igor reveals the arcanum-suppressing runes on his arm.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Hmph, always offering a devil's bargain. Another clause in that twisted code of yours?
The static from the communicator fades, leaving the tent in a dreadful silence.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Not thinking of playing with your fireflies again, are you?

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Bereggrad is unlike "that battlefield." Tens of thousands have stayed in the city. Raining fire from above will do us no good.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: Heh. No!
He looks down at the jar in his hand. The fireflies inside flicker and flutter.

items.speaker: Igor
items.text: I will take action only at the right time and place. Our goals remain the same: to win this battle for everyone.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: My horse, Sternova.

items.speaker: Sternova
items.text: Commander ...
She silences herself, furrows her brow, and leaves.
The commander turns to Igor with a wry smile and taps the table with his knuckle. Igor places his arm on the spot.
With a drawn dagger, Ivan pricks the rune-inscribed skin. The blade glows with arcane energy, flickering like a candle in a draft.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: That horse has carried me for years.
Blood wells up, flowing over taut muscle. But the hand holding the knife feels no pity.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: Steady. Brave. A loyal companion. Give the command, and he will charge into hell.
The cold steel warms with blood as the gentle neighing of warhorses reaches their ears.

items.speaker: Commander Ivan
items.text: But he's not used to the water beyond the steppe. Make sure you bring him home.
